writeup: The Odyssey JPEG 4.5 inch BMX peg (part A-221-BK, 14mm with a 3/8 inch adaptor, black) is $4.99 new at Woot. Planet BMX, 29ers Bike Shop and BikeBling all sell the same single peg for $18.99, and Tree Fort Bikes asks $23.99. It is heat-treated 4140 chromoly with three grind positions. Only 3 were left at last check, limit 3 per customer.
amazon_match_notes: Checker verified the Amazon ASIN B076B58RWJ is the exact Odyssey JPEG 4.5 in 14mm peg.
